description: E18 Perceiver AR v2 pilot mix (Polonez, 125M): PG-19 books for genuine >8k dependencies, FinePDFs for long coherent documents, FineWeb-Edu + stack-edu python for short-context fluency. Tokenized once at seq 32768 (SmolLM3 = Llama-3 vocabulary); training truncates to MAX_SEQ_LENGTH for the 8k stage. No cross-doc packing (per-document rows; right padding).

long_context_policy.notes: Long tier = PG-19 + FinePDFs. Eval rows >= 32k from PG-19 feed the position-bucket probe.
